decision: The no-shadow observed-frame theorem is exact if ordinary matter has only the quotient public frame and all frame functions factor through q.
Current MTS cannot claim c_g=b_dis=0 because the parent single-public-frame/no-extra-frame action clause is unsigned.
c_g and b_dis are retained as explicit nonclaim coefficient rows with arena projection requirements.
Single Public Metric may be used only as a labelled closure branch, not as derived MTS evidence.
Next target is no-marker/constant superselection: alpha_EM, masses, clock ratios, and material markers can reintroduce beta even after frame locking.
